description:
In-process scheduler that runs actions at scheduled times. Supports **SetTimes**, **Interval**, **OneShot**, and **Cron** schedules (5- or 6-field expressions) with
logging, metrics, and optional state persistence via `ISchedulerStateStore`.
features: **Schedule types.** `Interval` (periodic inside a window), `SetTimes` (explicit daily times), `OneShot` (single run), `Cron` (5- or 6-field expressions via [`Lyo.Schedule.Models.CronExpression`](../../Schedule/Lyo.Schedule.Models/README.md)).
**State persistence.** In-memory by default. Pluggable `ISchedulerStateStore` (e.g. cache-backed) so state survives a restart.
**Background execution.** Actions run in the background by default. Optional action timeout.

Add a scheduled action. `true` when the id is new; `false` when that `id` is already registered.
Run an existing schedule immediately, ignoring cadence.
`ScheduleCalculator` yields the next occurrence for all four schedule types.
sections.trail:
`ScheduleCalculator` is the evaluator underneath: it dispatches to `GetNextRunSetTimes` / `GetNextRunInterval` / `GetNextRunOneShot` / `GetNextRunCron`. Cron evaluation first tries
`CronFormat.IncludeSeconds` (6 fields) and falls back to the standard 5-field format.

sections.title: Schedule kinds (Lyo.Schedule.Models)
items: **SetTimes.** Fire at specific times each day (e.g. 09:00, 17:00).
**Interval.** Fire every N minutes/hours inside a daily window.
**OneShot.** Fire once at a specific time.
